criteria.label: Demo criterion (NSAID with an anticoagulant)
criteria.title: Test stand-in: an NSAID supplied with an oral anticoagulant
criteria.statement: A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) supplied to a person who is also being supplied an oral anticoagulant (risk of major bleeding).

criteria.plain_summary: An anti-inflammatory pain medicine and a blood thinner supplied together can raise the risk of serious bleeding.
criteria.rule_for_models: Suspect a finding when at least one Group A medicine AND at least one Group B medicine both appear in the history with supply dates that overlap or fall within 60 days of each other.
criteria.cannot_be_seen: Why the anticoagulant was started, kidney function, any history of bleeding, and any pain or stomach medicines bought without a prescription.
criteria.ask_the_gp: Whether the NSAID is still needed while the anticoagulant continues, and the patient's risk of bleeding.

result.whatMatches: The patient was supplied rivaroxaban (Xarelto) on 2026-07-08 (L030), 2026-08-08 (L035), 2026-09-08 (L040), and 2026-10-08 (L045), which overlaps with supplies of celecoxib (Celebrex) on 2026-08-21 (L036) and 2026-09-20 (L041).
result.whatCannotBeSeen: A dispensing history does not show whether the patient actually took the medications, the specific timing of doses relative to each other, or any clinical contraindications or protective measures (such as PPI co-prescription) that might mitigate the bleeding risk.

draft.body:
Example Community Pharmacy (fictional)
1 Example Street, Exampletown
Phone: (00) 0000 0000
Pharmacist: The pharmacist on duty

18 November 2026

To: Dr F. Example (fictional)
Example Family Practice

Patient: Fictional patient F-001, female, 72 years
Fictional patient. No real person.

Re: Clinical query regarding Celebrex and Xarelto for Fictional patient F-001

Dear Doctor,

I am writing to note that this 72 year old female patient is being supplied a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) alongside an oral anticoagulant. This combination may increase the risk of major bleeding.

The patient has been supplied Xarelto 20 mg tablet on 8 July 2026, 8 August 2026, 8 September 2026, and 8 October 2026. Additionally, Celebrex 200 mg capsule was supplied on 21 August 2026 and 20 September 2026.

Could you please review whether the NSAID is still needed while the anticoagulant continues, and assess the patient's risk of bleeding? Please let us know if you require any further information.

The criterion this is based on
Demo criterion (NSAID with an anticoagulant): A non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) supplied to a person who is also being supplied an oral anticoagulant (risk of major bleeding).
